market_holds: Spot $9.315 at the 2026-11-13 seal, 3% above the 52-week low and 65% below the high. Options (front expiry 11-20) price a straddle of 8.64% and an event move of about 6.2%, with calls bid over puts (25d skew -3.3 vol points) and put/call OI 0.38 (sealed baseline). Short interest is 4.8% of shares, 7.4 days to cover (FINRA 2026-10-30 via equibles, from the sweep row). The baseline's 'history' is mostly monthly delivery 6-Ks and is not an earnings base rate. From the press, the last four results reactions turned on the next-quarter delivery guide: Nov-2025 Q4 guide below the Street (fell); Mar-2026 Q1 guide 61-66k against about 84k expected (fell); May-2026 Q2 guide 100-106k above the 97k consensus (rose about 4%); Aug-2026 Q3 guide 115-121k judged weak (about -10%). Q3 deliveries of 118,390 are already public (mid-guide, so Q3 revenue should land near the RMB 22.5bn midpoint), and so is October's record 50,237. Aggregated consensus is stale: Q3 revenue consensus of about $3.85bn sits above the top of guidance (finviz 2026-11-09). The S&P FY2026 revenue mean of RMB 86.5bn (25 analysts, range 80.6-98.5bn; stockanalysis) less Q1-Q3 of about RMB 55.3bn implies roughly RMB 31bn for Q4. By my arithmetic that is about 176k deliveries, or more than 63k a month in Nov-Dec, slightly above management's own 'over 60k a month' ambition. Run-in: -8.6% from 11-06 to 11-13, in step with KWEB (-8.0%), LI (-7.0%) and NIO (-13.9%) (Yahoo daily closes), so it is the China tape, not company news. Over 20 days XPEV is flat while KWEB is -7%, helped by October's record. Brokers have turned Hold or Neutral (JPM $10 on Oct 30, UBS $12, Barclays Sell $14, GS Buy $16).
view: The print trades on the Q4 delivery and revenue guide, not on Q3, which is effectively pre-announced. October gave a strong base: a record 50,237, exports of 13,326, and the Mona L05 delivering from Nov 1 with a 10k first-month target. To meet the CEO's 'over 60k a month in Q4' the guide needs about 170-180k. Against that, China's domestic market is weak: CPCA October NEV retail -13.7% YoY, the first 8 days of November -7%, inventory pressure flagged, and October export strength partly pulled forward by rebate and tariff windows. XPeng's October domestic volume was flat YoY. XPeng has a record of guiding below a Street that sits too high (three of the last four guides disappointed). The consensus mean that can be backed out sits at or above the company's own stretch target, so a guide in the 160-172k range would read as another miss on headlines. In mitigation, expectations in the price are plainly low: near the 52-week low, brokers already cut to Hold with $10-12 targets, preview articles calling expectations low, and calls bid over puts. A guide that only meets 60k a month could set off a relief rally. I lean slightly negative but cannot show what the true (median, recent) Q4 consensus is, and the weekend China tape is an unknown. No recommendation.
unpriced: Possibly the stale consensus. The FY2026 revenue mean implies a Q4 at or above management's own stretch target, and the Q3 revenue consensus still sits above the guided range, so a realistic guide may print as a 'miss' against aggregated numbers again. The evidence is not strong enough to say the price, which already discounts weak guides, does not hold this.

recommendation.reason: The deciding line is the Q4 delivery/revenue guide. Consensus (mean RMB 86.5bn FY) appears to need more than 63k units a month in Nov-Dec, which is above management's own ambition, in a domestic market down double digits YoY. That gives a mild tilt toward a disappointing headline. But the stock is near its low with downgraded targets and call-side skew, so a guide of 60k a month could equally spark a relief rally. Direction confidence is well below 65.
recommendation.what_would_flip_it: A Q4 delivery guide with a midpoint of 175k or more (over 62k a month in Nov-Dec), or a vehicle margin back above 13%, would make the move up likely.

self_critique: The FY revenue mean is distorted by stale high estimates (range up to RMB 98.5bn), so the true live Q4 bar may be well below 176k, and management has signalled 60k a month publicly. A guide of 170-180k with Mona L05 and exports could beat a bar that has quietly come down, against a stock at its lows with call-side positioning, which is a relief-rally setup. I also never found November weekly data, the most direct evidence. A one-day tape move in China ADRs could swamp either side.
approach_notes: P6 (find the line from past reactions; take the run-in apart against peers) and the P4 stale-consensus/outlier bias were the useful parts. Weekly registration data, the freshest series per P3, was not findable through search, which left the deciding input unobserved.
